# Community Sale Help

> We run HOA and neighborhood community garage sales for boards and neighborhood groups anywhere in the US: signups, the map, signs, flyers and promotion. Run by Clark Richardson.

## Main pages
- [Home: HOA community garage sale, done for you](https://communitysalehelp.com/): what we handle, how it works, request form and FAQ.

## Planning guides
- [How to Organize an HOA Garage Sale, Step by Step](https://communitysalehelp.com/how-to-organize-an-hoa-garage-sale/): The steps for a board or volunteer, from approval to leftovers.
- [HOA Garage Sale Checklist: Printable, Week by Week](https://communitysalehelp.com/hoa-garage-sale-checklist/): Every board decision and task, week by week, ready to print.
- [HOA Garage Sale Organizer: How Our Process Works](https://communitysalehelp.com/how-it-works/): What we handle, what your board does, and how remote sales work.
- [HOA Garage Sale Cost: What Goes Into the Budget](https://communitysalehelp.com/hoa-garage-sale-cost/): What goes into the budget and who usually pays.
- [HOA Garage Sale FAQ: Answers for Boards and Residents](https://communitysalehelp.com/faq/): Answers for boards and residents.

## Related
- [Garage Sale Listings](https://garagesaleagents.com/): a community garage sale kit for real estate agents.
